experiment: Basic Stage 1 and authors' recipe on all usable 2014-2015 pipeline acquisitions; profiles fixed before evaluation, no holdout or lidar tuning.

visual_review.finding: All 20 RGB crops inspected. No visible cloud, haze or obvious RGB misregistration. Winter cast-building shadows are pronounced around the central courtyard but localized; roofs and street features remain readable, with no broad heavy shadow obscuring the block. Retain 19 training acquisitions. Seasonal tint, vegetation, vehicle and illumination changes remain limitations. Holdout reviewed only for source QC, never profile or model selection.

limits.reason: The 17-view basic run took 26 minutes, close to the former 30-minute basic limit. Both profiles fixed at two hours before evaluation; splat and memory caps unchanged.

decision.rule: The run with lower registered all-labelled MAE wins only with >=0.2 m improvement over the five-view basic baseline and no ground/building/vegetation MAE regression >0.3 m.
decision.reason: Recipe has the lower registered all-labelled MAE (1.358702 m), improves over five-view basic by 1.458298 m (>=0.2 m), and improves every class (no regression >0.3 m). Publish for review without activation.

floater_removal.note: Fixed before inspecting 19-view removal statistics: allow at most 1% of total activated raw opacity mass to be removed, bounding removal to a small share of model opacity. Mass is sum(sigmoid(raw opacity)), not splat count or volume. Remove only ENU horizontal centre radius >350 m before fusion; existing extent, vertical and transform gates remain unchanged.

extent.frame: metric ENU at the recorded anchor
extent.note: Coarse sanity envelope only. Border floaters extend the full bbox beyond the nominal 250 m block plus 20 m halo; this is not an accuracy measurement.

render_equivalence.method: Render the raw final model and the fused PLY with the same Skyfall renderer and cameras, with identical ENU floater subsets (including per-splat appearance embeddings); PSNR is between the two renders over valid mask pixels at the evaluation resolution.

reference.source: DFC2019 Track3-Truth (HSIP airborne lidar, ANPS about 0.8 m), via the Sat-NeRF EarthVision2022 dataset.zip
reference.heights: WGS84 ellipsoidal (ground median about -17 m; orthometric would be about +12 m here)
reference.acquisition_date: unknown (HSIP U.S. Cities lidar; not stated in the DFC2019/US3D papers)

method.placement: fused export placed by model_to_enu then enu_to_ecef, converted to UTM with ellipsoidal heights
method.dsm: max height per cell of back-projected rendered depth (see depth-report.json)
method.deviation: Same rendered-depth principle as Skyfall, from one synthetic nadir camera instead of its camera path
method.registration: Skyfall-GS/Sat-NeRF dsmr: recursive NCC shift, z offset, no z scaling
method.evaluated_extent: 250 m block (ENU square) inside the truth grid; CLS 65 (unlabelled) and water excluded from all_labelled

outputs.comparison_png: dsm-comparison.png (truth | splat DSM | unregistered error | registered error; error scale +/-5 m, red = splats too high)

visual_review.evaluation: Full comparison.png reviewed: building and road structure recognizable, cross-date colour mismatch and border smearing.

limitations: One 250 m block; lidar acquisition date unknown.
Wider acquisition span includes seasonal and construction change.
Joint recipe comparison, not an isolated MoGe ablation.
Known ENU anchor: registration shift measures placement relative to this lidar.

first_attempt.error: COLMAP database image/camera mapping differs from training inputs

fix.description: Single-thread feature extraction preserves image_id == camera_id required by the pinned initializer. Existing mapping check unchanged; fresh attempt passed. No geometry or quality gate changed.

pseudo_views.generation: Synthetic 60-degree FOV orbit cameras around random targets; elevation 80 to 45 degrees, radius 300 to 250 model units. No acquisition camera poses or RGBs read.
pseudo_views.appearance_ids: random.randint(0, num_train_cams - 1), num_train_cams=19 from scene.getTrainCameras(); holdout excluded.

interpretation: Pipeline 19-view recipe reaches 1.359 m registered MAE with known anchor, improves all classes, and passes the unchanged fixed rule. Basic regresses to 3.027 m. Holdout appearance regresses for both (16.64/15.49 vs 17.73 dB); no holdout-driven choices. Recipe published inactive; five-view baseline remains active.
